verdict.rationale: The docs describe a process to "upload equity promises in bulk" (docs-4), and promises can be converted automatically into grants via the Gusto integration (docs-18). This is bulk intake adjacent to grant issuance, but not a documented bulk import of actual grants. Historical capture runs through per-workflow "upload" paths for previously signed documents (docs-19), and predefined vesting schedules only speed up entering grants one at a time (docs-2). Missing for 10: documented bulk import of issued grants/securities, bulk upload of historical transactions, file format or template details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
